resources.string:
Uses your phone’s built-in backup service. Choose your Google account and enable backup in the phone’s backup settings.

Includes rules, global whitelist, pending changes, themes, app preferences and accountability partners. Traffic logs and downloaded APKs are excluded.

Android controls when backups run and restores them when you reinstall DomainGuard or set up another phone. A request does not confirm that a backup has finished.
Backup requested. Android decides when it runs.
